ExonRelevance.description:
Clinical relevance of the exon containing (or affected by) the VBC across
disease-relevant transcripts (SM 18): ALL (×1.0), MOST (×0.5), FEW (×0).
ExonRelevance.title: ExonRelevance

MissensePredictor.description: A calibrated in-silico missense predictor, pre-selected per VBC (SM 6).
MissensePredictor.title: MissensePredictor

description:
The amino-acid predictive (MIS_PRD) step: one calibrated predictor.

Transcript relevance (ExonRelevance) reduces positive points; the molecular-
mechanism axis is deliberately not applied on the missense amino-acid path,
since predictors capture both loss- and gain-of-function effects.

adjusted_points.description: Coded MIS_PRD points after transcript relevance (−4.0 to +4.0).
adjusted_points.title: Adjusted Points

initial_points.description: Calibrated points before the transcript-relevance step.
initial_points.title: Initial Points

raw_score.description: The predictor's raw score, if applicable.
raw_score.title: Raw Score
